load_masked_lm_model: load a masked language model from Hugging Face for the fill-mask task and wrap it in MaskedLMExportableModule
load_masked_lm_model_quantized: load a masked language model with 4-bit or 8-bit linear quantization for ExecuTorch export
export_masked_lm_for_executorch: export a BERT-style masked LM to ExecuTorch using the fill-mask task loader
quantize_masked_lm_model: quantize a masked language model's linear and embedding layers before wrapping for ExecuTorch export
register_fill_mask_task: register a fill-mask task function using the register_task decorator in the task registry
